title: Chapter 13
text: Dear Whoever, I had all the chances to make something of my life, and I blew every one of them. Through my own carelessness and misfortune, the world has retreated from me, and so now it makes perfect sense that I should retreat from the world . If I felt it was possible to stay, I would. But I don’t. And so I can’t. I make life worse for people . I have nothing to give. I’m sorry . Be kind to each other . Bye, Nora
